key.name: daemon-url
key.description: Where the collector is listening. Loopback when the daemon runs on this machine; a Tailscale address when it runs elsewhere, in which case the daemon requires a token before it will bind to anything non-loopback.

key.name: daemon-token
key.summary: Bearer token, if the daemon requires one
key.description: Must match [daemon] token in the daemon's config.toml. Empty when the daemon is on loopback, where it accepts unauthenticated requests.

key.name: show-percentage
key.summary: Show the most-constrained figure beside the icon
key.description: Off leaves only the icon, which still changes colour with severity.

key.name: notifications
key.summary: Notify when a meter crosses into warning or critical
key.description: Alerts are edge-triggered by the daemon, so this is one notification per crossing rather than one per poll.
